parts.html: The K-18 standard model is a contemporary L-shaped kitchen in a restrained gray palette, combining clean geometry, solid-color laminated fronts, and a well-thought-out use of space. The model is designed for interiors where functionality, visual harmony, and efficient use of the available area matter.

Gray gives the kitchen a calm, elegant character. The neutral palette allows the furniture to blend harmoniously with light walls, natural wood, stone textures, decorative plaster, and contemporary flooring.

Thanks to its versatile color scheme, the K-18 kitchen suits apartments, condos, and private homes. The solid-color surfaces form a cohesive furniture composition without overloading the interior with extra decorative elements.

The model’s defining feature is its L-shaped configuration with a length of 4.8 linear meters. Placing the kitchen cabinets along two adjoining walls makes it easy to organize work surfaces, built-in appliances, and storage.

This layout is especially relevant for rooms where the floor area must be used efficiently while keeping open space for a dining area. Without a separate island, the layout is more flexible and allows for an efficient flow of movement within the kitchen.

The upper and lower fronts are made of laminated chipboard. The single material and solid gray finish emphasize the contemporary character of the furniture, creating a neat and visually coherent interior.
The chipboard-based countertop completes the kitchen composition and provides a functional work surface for everyday cooking. The carcass is made of 18 mm laminated chipboard.
Particular attention has been paid to convenient storage. The design includes a cargo pull-out for organizing food, kitchen utensils, and other everyday essentials.

For comfortable everyday use, Muller soft-close hinges ensure the doors close smoothly. The drawers run on concealed Muller slides that maintain the furniture’s clean aesthetic and provide easy access to the cabinet contents.
The kitchen is designed for built-in appliances. Cabinet handles are included with the model. Lift-up mechanisms are not included.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs and makes custom kitchens for apartments, condos, and private homes in Bratislava and Vienna.

The K-18 standard model can be adapted to the specific dimensions of your room, taking into account the location of utility connections and built-in appliances, as well as the client’s storage preferences.

When developing a custom design, the cabinet dimensions, the configuration of work surfaces, and the number of storage systems can be adjusted, and the shade of the fronts can be chosen to match the overall interior concept.
We offer comprehensive services covering kitchen furniture design, selection of materials and hardware, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
At the client’s request, the kitchen can also be fitted with a sink, appliances, a range hood, and plumbing fixtures.
You can order the K-18 kitchen or get a personalized price quote from DUMSKAYA DESIGN.
